title: Smoke on the Horizon
text: From the rise above the stream the drones can see the village: stilt huts round a fire, drying racks, a child chasing something through the reeds. Not a camp. A village, old enough to have paths worn into the ground. Tall people, thin, dark-eyed. Human.

lines.text: "So this is where they come from. There are more of them than I thought. There are more of them than us."
